# Batch performance log — 2026-11-16 (weekly)

Source: `panel/inbox/2026-11-16/135225-weekly/` (YouTube Studio export). Full analysis: `docs/marketing/audits/2026-11-16-135225-audit.md`. Mode: batch (Kallaway playbook §7).

## Caveats

- No lead capture is live — judged on on-target views, CTR, impressions, and subs, not leads. Leads per video: TBD.
- Retention, saves, shares: TBD (not in export).
- Too new to judge (posted within ~3 days): `jmWifM1ANAs`, `e2xFRuH4sIo`, `em1WmvfsSmU`, `KIMwoQiMGds`, `m8wz-4O1Tr0`. The wrap-removal Short (`jmWifM1ANAs`, ~1,569 views in ~1 day) is a strong early signal — revisit next run.
- Shorts and long-form scored as separate cohorts.

## What won (keep)

- Long-form: specific car + specific job how-tos. BMW M3 bushings "with PLASTIC?!" (693 views, 6.84% CTR), yellow-headlight restore (654), Mustang springs (474), Sienna reset detail (459).
- Shorts: searchable how-to + on-target detailing with a local CTA. Escalade door handle (1,431 views, 7,855 impressions), minivan detail (1,401), "full detail Fremont" (907 views, 8.14% CTR).

## What lagged (pause)

- Vlog / event / shop-BTS long-form: shop-revamp series (56–112), Peaky Blinders party (149), Cars & Coffee (89), SEMA vlogs. High CTR but tiny impressions — YouTube stops serving off-target topics.
- Off-target Shorts: Peaky Blinders Short (25 views, 0.43% CTR), brown rice (297), church bells (997).

## Flags

- Wrong-audience hit, do not chase: `apK_Ur-_EZs` Lamborghini STO ride — highest-view Short (1,789) but enthusiast/viral-bait tags, 2 subs, no service fit.
- Packaging failure, A/B candidate: `hauU1eIK4m8` Murciélago — 7,625 impressions at 1.0% CTR (worst click-rate, most reach) yet 4 subs (most on the channel). Topic is on-target; the thumbnail/title is the brick at fault.

## Hypothesis for next batch

On-target, searchable specific-car + specific-problem how-tos earn both the impressions YouTube rewards and clicks from likely DIY/local buyers; vlog/event/BTS content underperforms on views and skews off-target. Packaging is the biggest lever on already-served videos.

## One change to test (one variable)

Make every long-form a searchable specific-problem how-to titled `{Year/Car} {Specific Problem} {Fix}`; hold the DIY format constant and change only topic selection toward service/repair jobs with search demand. Pause standalone vlog/event uploads except the sanctioned SEMA brand pilot. Measure CTR and impressions vs this batch.

## A/B test

Re-package Murciélago (`hauU1eIK4m8`): new thumbnail only, title held, 14-day timebox at current traffic. Measure CTR lift from the 1.0% floor.

No 10×+ on-target breakout — no locked triple-down formula yet. This is Phase 1 (skill development): consistent on-target output, not a viral chase.
